transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I’m here because I spend most of my day just going back over the same things in the house. The outlets, the locks, my tools... even the dust. I just keep checking and fixing them again and again. I do it until I’m completely worn out, but I still just don't feel sure enough to leave it alone.
When you feel the urge to check these things, what are you worried might happen if you don't?

Well, it's... I get these really ugly thoughts. Even when I know I did the job right, they just keep jumping in. I'll start thinking that maybe there's a loose wire I missed, and it's going to burn the whole house down. Or... maybe I left a nail somewhere on the floor and my wife is going to step on it and get hurt. I try to just push them out of my head, tell myself everything is fine, but they just come right back stronger.
How long have you been dealing with these intrusive thoughts and the need to repeatedly check things?

I'm not exactly sure, to be honest. It... it feels like it's been going on for a long time, but I couldn't give you a specific date or year or anything. I just don't really know when it started taking over my whole day like this.
